description: This Kotlin source file defines a class ConnectionLiveData that extends LiveData to monitor network connectivity status changes on Android devices. It registers a network callback to listen for network availability and loss, and posts updates about the current network type (WiFi, Ethernet, MobileData, Other, Lost) to observers.

classes.name: ConnectionLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that observes network connectivity changes and provides updates on the current network connection type.

classes.name: ConnectionType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of network connections: Lost, WiFi, Ethernet, MobileData, Other.

methods.name: ConnectionLiveData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the network callback registration to monitor network status changes.
